This proposal is that follow-up but does not reference or build on the experiment.","evidence_quote":"Drivers report frustration when orders are not ready at pickup.","citations":["experiment-registry#exp-040-pickup-wait-compensation"],"recommendation":"Reference EXP-040, cite its learning that readiness is the fix, and use its results as a baseline for acceptance and cost."}]}
